title: The Manager — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The manager stands in the technical area
Which is a rectangle of turf that represents
The precise limits of what a manager can actually do
Once the whistle goes

[Verse 2 — Español]
El entrenador tenía un plan [The manager had a plan]
El plan era excelente [The plan was excellent]
El plan tenía en cuenta la mayoría de las cosas [The plan accounted for most things]
No tuvo en cuenta al lateral izquierdo [It did not account for the left back]
Que tenía un plan completamente diferente [Having a completely different plan]
Desde el momento en que comenzó el juego [From the moment play began]

[Chorus — English]
The manager says — this is what we trained for
The manager says — stick to the shape
The players say — yes gaffer
And then do what the game requires
Which is frequently not the shape

[Bridge — Français]
Chas disait — l'entraîneur est la personne la plus optimiste du football [Chas said — the manager is the most optimistic person in football]
Ils croient, au début de chaque saison [They believe, at the start of every season]
Que cette fois les joueurs feront [That this time the players will do]
Exactement ce qui a été discuté à l'entraînement [Exactly what was discussed in training]
Chas disait — ça n'est jamais arrivé une seule fois dans l'histoire du jeu [Chas said — this has never happened once in the history of the game]

[Verse 3 — English]
The plan met reality — and one of them blinked

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The manager
El entrenador [The manager]
L'entraîneur [The manager]
That's my boy
